name: set
question: Is there a persistent list or set of entities the person chooses from?
counts: a table, list or grid of items of one kind that stays on screen and from which items can be selected or acted on
not: a table that is one panel of summaries with nothing selectable; a single item

name: detail
question: Is one selected item's detail shown beside or over the set, with the set still available?
counts: a detail pane, drawer or inspector tied to selection, opened by default or by a working control
not: detail that replaces the set; a drawer that nothing can open

name: decision
question: Can the person take a decision on each item individually?
counts: per-item actions (retry, approve, escalate) on the item or on the current item
not: page-level buttons (export, refresh); bulk actions only

name: progress
question: Is progress through the set visible?
counts: N of M, done and remaining, a position, a count of resolved against pending

name: compare
question: Does the main content set two or more objects against each other on the same measures?
counts: columns or cards per object on shared measures
not: several unrelated metrics; one object with its own history

name: single
question: Is the main content devoted to one object?
counts: a profile or record of one entity with its data, context or history
not: a set of entities; a summary of many

name: summary
question: Is there a row of three or more summary numbers about the whole set before the main content?
counts: three or more separate metric tiles about the set
not: numbers about one object; tiles after the main content
